We deliver transformative cyber and physical security solutions that safeguard digital landscapes and empower communities to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.
Redefining OT cybersecurity with trust and collaboration
In today’s high-stakes operational environments, the cost of outdated cybersecurity practices can be severe and far-reaching. Traditional IT controls often fall short when applied to OT systems, leading to unplanned downtime, safety risks, and loss of stakeholder trust.
Our latest whitepaper explores why trust-based collaboration is the key to securing OT environments, and how organizations can rethink their security approach from the ground up.
What’s inside?
•    The cost of misapplying IT security in OT contexts
•    Why traditional best practices no longer apply
•    How to embed security into the EPC lifecycle
•    What makes a true Trusted Advisor
•    Actionable recommendations for asset owners, vendors, and regulators
From adopting IEC 62443 to empowering Trusted Advisors and aligning with industry-specific standards, the paper offers a practical roadmap for building secure, resilient, and future-ready OT environments.

the paper now to access practical insights and proven strategies for OT security.

Our Approach
Our Approach to
Delivering Excellence
CPX excels in the core principles of cyber resilience: Assess, Protect, Operate. We assess your security posture, build security into your systems, and monitor them for threats. We act swiftly and effectively to neutralize any cyber threat.
Assess
We determine your business’s risk appetite through understanding of your objectives and regulatory requirements. We establish security strategies to manage risk and meet compliance.
Operate
We develop service models and establish 24/7 cyber-managed services and monitoring to ensure your business can operate with confidence. We also offer incident response services so that you can rapidly return to business in the worst-case scenario.
Protect
Following a ‘security by design’ approach, we implement countermeasures to build appropriate posture and ensure existing controls are optimally configured.
